name: Rust Number Guess
description:
Speedy number guessing in Rust. Learn systems programming.

   $ cargo run
   Guess (1-100): 50
   Too High!
   Guess (1-100): 25
   Too Low!
   Guess (1-100): 37
   You Win! 🎉

Learn: Rust, cargo, pattern matching, error handling.

fields.label: Your name
fields.help: Shown in the welcome and victory messages.

fields.label: Difficulty
fields.help: Easy: 1-50 with 10 guesses. Normal: 1-100 with 7 guesses. Hard: 1-200 with 5 guesses.
